_comment: Scenario ids excluded by the per-item audit (scripts/audit_bridge_items.py), which read every scenario for what its GRADED TURN actually asks rather than trusting session-level metadata. Three reasons: no_error_present -- the student is correct, acknowledging, asking a question or ending the session, so D1/D2 (both critical, 'identify the error') are unpassable; not_gradeable -- the error exists but is not recoverable from the visible text; not_mathematics -- the graded turn is session admin or tool talk, not a maths task. These survived the visual cuts because Bridge's free-text 'no mistake' filter only caught rows where an annotator SAID so in words; these carry a clean error label. Read by scripts/ingest_bridge.py; committed so the build stays deterministic.
